  "limitations_stated": [
    "High heterogeneity across studies, especially in meta-analyses of IL-6 and TNF-α protein levels following one-challenge.",
    "High heterogeneity between animal studies may be explained by different models to induce illness or injury and varying regimens of stimulant dosing with uncertain similarity to human conditions.",
    "Problems of internal validity of animal studies, including poor study design, conduct, analysis or reporting contribute to untranslatable replications in human trials.",
    "Lack of blinding of treatments in animal studies results in overestimates of the effect of the intervention.",
    "Most studies did not mention whether random allocation or blinded intervention and assessment were performed.",
    "Several meta-analyses include only two studies due to the shortage of studies which used similar methods for investigating sepsis.",
    "Species differences in underlying biology between humans and animals lead to failures in assessing efficacy and safety of interventions at human clinical trials.",
    "Mouse models show low correlation of gene expression changes in endotoxemia to human orthologs, and poorly mimic the genomic responses in patients with sepsis and infections.",
    "Basic dissimilarities in immune responses between human and murine species exist.",
    "The experimental handicap of using LPS at non-toxic safe doses in human in vivo models."
  ],

  "key_numbers": [
    "49 million incident cases worldwide in 2017",
    "11 million sepsis-related deaths that account for 19.7% of all global deaths",
    "70% of patients who died from sepsis within three days or several weeks after the initial onset of the disorder, showed marked immunosuppression with decreased cytokine production",
    "16302 studies were identified through database searches",
    "8549 duplicate studies were removed",
    "25 additional studies were added through citation tracking and reference checking",
    "149 studies were selected after titles and abstracts screening",
    "49 studies were included in the systematic review",
    "12 studies reported data from experiments performed using in vivo human model",
    "34 studies used rodents (mice or rats)",
    "three used sheep",
    "one used cows",
    "one used pigs",
    "12 human studies used LPS administration with in vivo doses of 2–4 ng/kg",
    "16 animal studies used LPS administration with in vivo doses of 0.1–45 mg/kg in mouse or 2–400 μg/mouse via injection or 100 μg/mL via inhalation in mouse or 10 mg/lamb/injection, and with ex vivo doses of 1–1000 μg/mL",
    "eight used treatments with bacteria (6000–10 7 colony-forming units (CFUs))",
    "six used CLP model",
    "one used cecal slurry injection",
    "three studies used experimental colitis model",
    "one animal study used lipoteichoic acid",
    "one used 10–40 μg/mouse CpG DNA",
    "two used 500 nmole 1V136 or 20–100 μg R848",
    "25 μg/mouse Pam3CSK4",
    "25 μg/mouse pIC",
    "20 studies (12 mouse studies and 8 human studies) in which two-challenge intervention was performed",
    "nine studies made use of IRAK3 gene knockout or silencing",
    "44 studies measured outcomes at intervals ranging between 1h and 72h following the first challenge",
    "several studies measured outcomes at 5d, 7d, 10d, or 14d",
    "After the second challenge, outcomes of interest were measured between 2h and 24h",
    "Human and mouse in vivo models observed significant increases of TNF-α and IL-6 levels at ST (1h to 3h), and IRAK3 mRNA expression at IT (4h and 6h) after one-challenge",
    "IRAK3 was reported to have significant effect on TNF-α mRNA and protein expressions at 6h and 24h following in vivo challenge of mice with bacteria",
    "Meta-analysis of IRAK3 mRNA expression in human in vivo studies shows significant increase at IT following administration with LPS (two studies, P = 0.03, I 2 = 43%)",
    "IRAK3 mRNA expression in humans were significantly induced at 2h (ST), and reached maximum level at 4h and 6h (IT), followed by decreases at 8h (IT) and 24h (LT) after LPS administration",
    "IRAK3 protein expression reached peak at 2-3h (ST), and decreased to baseline at 24h (LT)",
    "Meta-analysis of IRAK3 mRNA expression in rodent models identified significant increases at LT following in vivo challenge using CLP procedure, bacteria or LPS (six studies, P < 0.00001, I 2 = 46%)",
    "IRAK3 mRNA expression markedly increased in lung macrophages or homogenates, intestinal mucosa and liver from mice between ST and LT, reached peak at 24h (LT) following one-challenge with CLP/ LPS/ K . pneumoniae",
    "In rats, the increase of IRAK3 mRNA expression in eye tissue was reported at 5d following one-challenge with LPS",
    "IRAK3 mRNA expression in cow mammary tissue significantly increased at LT (24h)",
